svg.title: cutting
svg.text: PEDAL KAYAK cut file: each panel's neutral layer, outside up, on a blank of three 2440 × 1220 sheets scarfed end to end
Blank A, 9 mm: port and starboard garboards; the transom (right)
Blank B, 6 mm: port and starboard middle strakes, port and starboard sheer strakes
Scarfs 2440 apart. Red: the keel edges, which meet.
